mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transport_trip ( id, trip_code, schedule_id, from_hub_id, to_hub_id, vehicle_id, scheduled_departure_at, planned_arrival_at, estimated_arrival_at, actual_departure_at, actual_arrival_at, capacity_weight, reserved_weight, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tripCode}, #{scheduleId}, #{fromHubId}, #{toHubId}, #{vehicleId}, #{scheduledDepartureAt}, #{plannedArrivalAt}, #{estimatedArrivalAt}, #{actualDepartureAt}, #{actualArrivalAt}, #{capacityWeight}, #{reservedWeight}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO transport_trip ( id, trip_code, schedule_id, from_hub_id, to_hub_id, vehicle_id, scheduled_departure_at, planned_arrival_at, estimated_arrival_at, actual_departure_at, actual_arrival_at, capacity_weight, reserved_weight, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tripCode}, #{scheduleId}, #{fromHubId}, #{toHubId}, #{vehicleId}, #{scheduledDepartureAt}, #{plannedArrivalAt}, #{estimatedArrivalAt}, #{actualDepartureAt}, #{actualArrivalAt}, #{capacityWeight}, #{reservedWeight}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (schedule_id, scheduled_departure_at) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, trip_code, schedule_id, from_hub_id, to_hub_id, vehicle_id, scheduled_departure_at, planned_arrival_at, estimated_arrival_at, actual_departure_at, actual_arrival_at, capacity_weight, reserved_weight, status, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, trip_code, schedule_id, from_hub_id, to_hub_id, vehicle_id, scheduled_departure_at, planned_arrival_at, estimated_arrival_at, actual_departure_at, actual_arrival_at, capacity_weight, reserved_weight, status, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE trip_code = #{tripCode}

SELECT id, trip_code, schedule_id, from_hub_id, to_hub_id, vehicle_id, scheduled_departure_at, planned_arrival_at, estimated_arrival_at, actual_departure_at, actual_arrival_at, capacity_weight, reserved_weight, status, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND scheduled_departure_at = #{scheduledDepartureAt}

SELECT id, trip_code, schedule_id, from_hub_id, to_hub_id, vehicle_id, scheduled_departure_at, planned_arrival_at, estimated_arrival_at, actual_departure_at, actual_arrival_at, capacity_weight, reserved_weight, status, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY scheduled_departure_at ASC
